handoff_context.purpose: Capture the key learnings, architectural insights, product observations, and hackathon direction from the setup and Modernize investigation.
handoff_context.status: Morning setup and architectural discovery complete enough to sharpen the project direction.

docker.learning: Docker should be treated primarily as reproducible packaging/runtime infrastructure, not as the core architecture problem.
docker.recommended_use_today: Build and validate locally first, then containerize if useful for demo reproducibility or service packaging.

azure.issue: Storage account creation returned SubscriptionNotFound even though subscription and resource group were visible.
azure.likely_cause_being_checked: Microsoft.Storage provider registration / Azure resource-provider state.
azure.learning: A readable and enabled Azure subscription does not guarantee that a particular resource provider is ready for writes.

dotnet.learning: The untouched sample repo builds successfully, giving a known-good baseline before Modernize changes anything.

modernize_cli.reason: claude-sonnet-4.6 was not available through the current Copilot entitlement/runtime.

current_understanding.copilot_cli: Primary AI runtime/auth layer used by Modernize.
current_understanding.model_access: Model availability depends on GitHub Copilot runtime/entitlement unless BYOK or another supported provider configuration is used.
current_understanding.byok: Copilot CLI can support bring-your-own-provider/key setups, but a ChatGPT or Claude Code subscription is not itself an API entitlement.
current_understanding.serviceability: Modernize can be automated or wrapped, but it is not exposed as a generic standalone SDK or HTTP modernization service.

modernize_runtime_model.important_distinction: The modernization workflow and domain logic are more durable than any single model provider.

assessment_findings.analysis_duration: Approximately one second for the raw AppCAT analysis.
assessment_findings.implication: The several-minute Modernize run was not primarily static analysis time; orchestration, download/setup, report generation, and AI workflow consumed most of the time.

example.target_specific_result: mandatory for Azure Container Apps and several other targets
example.interpretation: The assessment already produces machine-readable, target-aware, typed domain facts rather than relying on free-form LLM interpretation.

architecture_learnings.initial_hypothesis: Modernize might rely heavily on a frontier LLM to inspect source, understand the application, plan, and act.
architecture_learnings.updated_hypothesis: Modernize already uses deterministic/specialized analyzers to produce structured facts before agentic reasoning.
observed_pipeline: specialist deterministic assessment such as AppCAT
architecture_learnings.important_realization: Modernize already embodies much of the same architectural instinct that motivated the recent JEV/Semantic Compiler discussions: stable structure should be extracted by specialized software instead of repeatedly rediscovered by a large generative model.

jev_and_semantic_compiler_reframing.old_question: Could JEV or a Semantic Compiler make Modernize more typed and deterministic?
jev_and_semantic_compiler_reframing.new_question: How far should typed/deterministic domain encoding go before the cost of encoding the domain exceeds the value compared with letting a general LLM reason?
jev_and_semantic_compiler_reframing.new_insight: The interesting trade-off is not deterministic software versus LLMs in general. It is domain-engineering cost versus repeated model reasoning cost.

general_agent.best_for: rare, novel, one-off, highly ambiguous work

jev_and_semantic_compiler_reframing.principle: Type the parts of a domain that are encountered often enough that the cost of ambiguity exceeds the cost of encoding them.

machine_executable_domain_packages.definition: Community- or vendor-maintained bundles of typed rules, constraints, migration recipes, schemas, validators, compatibility knowledge, and decision logic that software and agents can execute instead of rediscovering domain knowledge from scratch.
machine_executable_domain_packages.why_the_term_matters: It makes clear that the artifact is more than documentation, prompts, RAG, or static knowledge. The domain representation is executable.
machine_executable_domain_packages.core_thesis: LLMs should not own stable domain knowledge. Communities, vendors, and organizations should encode stable domain knowledge as executable infrastructure that agents consume.
machine_executable_domain_packages.governance_question: Who owns the machine-executable representation of the domain?
machine_executable_domain_packages.model_independence: A domain package should be usable by Copilot, Codex, Claude Code, local models, CI, or even non-LLM software.

modernize_as_reference_architecture.lesson: Modernize should not necessarily be copied as a product, but its harness architecture can be abstracted.

agent_llm: code synthesis where recipes are insufficient

modernize_as_reference_architecture.abstraction_goal: Open-source the generic harness and make domain knowledge pluggable rather than embedding all domain expertise inside one vendor's agent.

openrewrite.role: Strongest precedent for community-maintained executable modernization knowledge.
openrewrite.implication: A large part of the community transformation layer already exists and should be reused rather than recreated.

codeql.role: Strong precedent for packaging, publishing, versioning, dependency management, and reusable executable analysis knowledge.
codeql.implication: The package-distribution model for machine-executable domain knowledge also already has mature precedents.

renovate.role: Strong precedent for a domain-agnostic harness with modular ecosystem adapters.
renovate.implication: The harness can own process while ecosystem-specific modules own domain knowledge.

rust.role: Smaller example of compiler-produced structured suggestions consumed by tooling such as cargo fix/rustfix.
rust.implication: Domain intelligence can live in language tooling and be consumed automatically without an LLM.

domain_fact.example: Spring Boot 2 API X is incompatible with Spring Boot 3.

vendor_package.example: Replace a messaging layer with Azure Service Bus.

organization_policy.example: This organization mandates Kafka and PostgreSQL.

layering_model.importance: These layers should remain explicit so vendor preference does not silently become universal domain truth.

high_value_roles: map business constraints onto typed alternatives
handle unsupported or genuinely novel cases
generate code when no trusted recipe exists
ideal_flow: LLM decision only where ambiguity remains

provenance_and_trust.value: Makes visible which parts of a modernization are community knowledge, organizational policy, vendor guidance, or genuinely invented by the LLM.

hackathon_direction.possible_build: A minimal open specification and harness showing how domain expertise can be portable, executable, provenance-aware, and independent of the consuming agent.
hackathon_direction.best_demo_domain: Java/Spring, because community-maintained transformation knowledge already exists.
demo_flow: deliberately leave one unsupported ambiguous task
delegate only that task to an LLM agent
hackathon_direction.demo_message: The agent is a client of the domain. It does not own the domain.

core_phrases: The agent is a client of the domain. It does not own the domain.
Build software with LLMs, not software out of LLMs.
Do not type the whole world. Type the parts you encounter repeatedly enough that the cost of ambiguity exceeds the cost of encoding them.
Modernize makes modernization agentic. Machine-executable domain packages make domain expertise portable.
open_research_questions: How much engineering effort did Microsoft spend encoding .NET and Java modernization knowledge compared with the value gained in reliability and repeatability?
Which Modernize planning and routing decisions are deterministic versus LLM-mediated?
What is the smallest useful standard for a machine-executable domain package?
Can existing OpenRewrite recipes be wrapped directly as package capabilities rather than copied?
Can CodeQL-style package dependency/version mechanics be reused conceptually?
How should conflicts between domain truth, vendor recommendations, organization policy, and user intent be resolved?
How should confidence and provenance propagate through a modernization DAG?
What is the break-even point where domain encoding becomes more valuable than repeated frontier-model reasoning?
Can this boundary be adaptive rather than manually engineered for every domain?

current_conclusion.summary: The main opportunity is not to make Microsoft Modernize more deterministic. Modernize already demonstrates a mature typed, tool-driven modernization architecture. The broader opportunity is to extract the architectural pattern into an open, vendor-neutral harness where stable domain expertise is packaged as machine-executable community infrastructure and any agent can consume it.
current_conclusion.project_thesis: Portable domain expertise is potentially more durable and strategically important than any particular agent or frontier model.
